PROJECT SHINOBI - how to play
=============================

EASIEST: download the one "ProjectShinobi-Windows" zip from GitHub Actions,
extract it, and run ProjectShinobi.exe. Everything is already together.

ProjectShinobi.exe needs ProjectShinobi.pck (the game itself) in the SAME
folder. If you got separate downloads, put those two side by side first.
Extract the rest into the same place (for example all into Downloads): the
game looks for characters_1/2/3.pck and audio_1.pck (music and voices)
beside the exe and in the folders next to it.
There's nothing to install. Windows may warn because the exe isn't
code-signed: click "More info" then "Run anyway".

If the title screen shows red CHARACTERS MISSING or MUSIC AND VOICES MISSING
text, the game couldn't find those .pck files. Move characters_1.pck,
characters_2.pck, characters_3.pck and audio_1.pck into the same folder as
ProjectShinobi.exe and restart.

The game opens on the title screen:
  Continue                  - pick up your last save at the next chapter.
  New Game                  - choose a save slot (there are three), then make
                              your shinobi: clan, eye art, name, look, gear
                              and jutsu loadout. Then the story begins.
  Load Game                 - your saves as cards: name, clan, chapters
                              cleared, play time. Each can be deleted (it
                              asks first).
  Chapters                  - replay any chapter you have unlocked.
  Trial of the Five Natures - five waves of enemy shinobi, one nature each.
  Training Ground           - dummies that don't hit back, for practice.
  Customize                 - face, hair and outfit from 9 VRoid characters,
                              colours, ninja gear, name, clan, eye art and
                              jutsu loadouts.
The game saves as you play. Settings (controls, audio) are shared by all
saves.

Keyboard + mouse and controller both work, and you can switch mid-game.
Controller buttons are named Xbox-style below. PlayStation and Nintendo
pads get their own labels in game.

IN THE FIELD                 KEYBOARD + MOUSE        CONTROLLER
  Move                       W A S D                 Left stick
  Camera                     Mouse                   Right stick
  Jump (again in air)        Space                   A
  Dash (tap) / Sprint (hold) Shift                   L3 (click left stick)
  Strike                     Left mouse              X
  Throw kunai                Q                       RT
  Guard (hold)               E                       RB
  Charge chakra (hold)       R                       Y
  Lock on                    Tab / middle mouse      R3
  WEAVE SEALS (hold)         Right mouse             LT
  Quick-cast jutsu 1-4       1 2 3 4                 D-pad
  Quick-cast jutsu 5-8       5 6 7 8                 D-pad, after Back flips the page
  Jutsu loadout prev / next  Z / X                   (rebind in Pause)
  Pause / settings           Esc                     Start

Kunai aim at whatever is near the middle of the screen, so there's no need
to lock on first.
Health slowly regenerates after about 4 seconds without taking a hit.
Hold Charge to refill chakra.

STORY
  A / Enter / Space / click: next line. Hold it to fast-forward.
  Chapters unlock in order. If you lose a fight, "Retry fight" restarts
  just that fight.

FIGHTING ENEMIES
  Each enemy shows its nature. Hit it with the nature that beats it for
  1.5x damage: Fire > Wind > Lightning > Earth > Water > Fire.
  SEALS ABOVE AN ENEMY'S HEAD = A JUTSU IS COMING. Hit it before the last
  seal to interrupt. A kunai stops a genin; chunin and jonin need more.
  A red "!" means a strike is winding up: guard or dash away.

WEAVING HAND SEALS
  Hold Weave, enter seals, release to cast.
  A seal is a direction, plus an optional bank modifier:

                 Bottom    Right    Left     Top
                 (S / A)   (D / B)  (A / X)  (W / Y)
  Bank I         Rat       Ox       Tiger    Hare
  Bank II        Dragon    Snake    Horse    Ram     (hold Shift / LB)
  Bank III       Monkey    Bird     Dog      Boar    (hold Space / RB)

  Example: Ember Volley = Tiger, Ox = left, right.
  Every jutsu and its seals are in Pause > Jutsu Scroll.
  Too slow between seals and the sequence breaks. Pause > Accessibility
  can widen the timing, turn it off, or switch to toggle mode.

CUSTOMIZE
  Pause > Customize: colours, gear (headband, mask, scarf, sword, pouch),
  height, name, and chakra nature. Jutsu of your nature cost 20% less.

SOUND
  Pause > Accessibility > Audio has Master, Effects and Menu volume.

RAY TRACING
  On graphics cards with hardware ray tracing (NVIDIA RTX, AMD RX 6000 or
  newer, Intel Arc) the sea mirrors the islands, and characters and props
  get ray-traced contact shadows. It's on by default; turn it off in
  Pause > Accessibility > Display if the frame rate drops. On other cards
  the option is greyed out and nothing changes.

Settings and your character save to %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Project Shinobi\
